resource.name: WAVScribe
resource.creator: Formosa Soundworks Studio
resource.description: Windows audio-post metadata editor for WAV/BWF, iXML, XMP and ID3, with batch/spreadsheet tools. Resolve field visibility is not established.
resource.platformNotes: Windows 10 1809+/11 x64, 4 GB RAM minimum. Local/external/NAS files supported; cloud-synced folders are not officially supported.

requirements.dependencies: Internet activation and periodic checks; up to 30 days offline between checks.

evidence.note: Windows 10 1809+/11 x64, 4 GB RAM minimum. Local/external/NAS files supported; cloud-synced folders are not officially supported.

Windows audio-post companion for editing BWF/bext, iXML, XMP, LIST/INFO and ID3 metadata in WAV/RF64/BW64 files. Includes conflict inspection, UCS naming and spreadsheet round trips. Provider says audio bytes are not re-encoded; exact field visibility in Resolve is not established. Paid perpetual license with a seven-day trial.
